why: Stops judging the capacity flash against the drawn board. Issue #702's defect passed the gate exactly this way: at 844x390 the board's top edge is at y 48, under the 52px topbar, so a flash placed just below the bar cleared the bar and was drawn on the enemy tank row. The old stand-in, 'above the viewport centre', passed it too.
